title: Braiding Sweetgrass
author: Robin Wall Kimmerer
summary: Botanist and Potawatomi citizen Robin Wall Kimmerer weaves essays on plants, Indigenous teachings and science. She explores a relationship with the land based on reciprocity and gratitude.
readIf: you want gentle, lyrical nature writing that joins science with Indigenous perspectives.
skipIf: you want a technical ecology text or a fast-moving argument.
